name: FamiliesTips
description: Clan Primer Traveler's Tips: four ungated 'Weapon Families' tips carrying the per-family identity text (0.1.35 wording, 0.1.6 layout: a yellow heading per family trait, indented text, blank lines between entries, yellow cross-references) (moved off weapon help; that runtime feature is reverted separately). Extends the deployed 17-entry state: the 16 native tips plus the Proficiency tip. Titles go into penelosdiary rows 654-657 (IDs 0x16E0-0x16E3), found empty and unreferenced the same way row 661 was. Flag 255 writes check byte 2 = 0xFF, the format's own no-flag-test convention, so the game shows these tips unconditionally.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Heavy
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights in its own way.
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Greatsword: Sweep{/}
  Attacking a foe cleaves a half circle around it
  for half damage. The swing is slow.

{y}Axe: Sunder{/}
  Each hit dents the foe's Defense by 5 percent of
  its starting value, down to half, for the rest of
  the fight.
{y}Axe: Reckless{/}
  Each swing dents your own Defense by 5 percent,
  down to a quarter off.

{y}Hammer: Concussion{/}
  Disable 15 percent on hit, and a 30 percent
  knockback chance. The swing is slow.

{y}Spear: Pierce{/}
  Every hit ignores 30 percent of the foe's Defense.
  A spear never parries, except to counter, and a
  counter needs the {y}Counter{/} augment.
  It still blocks and dodges.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Light
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights in its own way.
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Sword: Guard{/}
  The best weapon evade, 20 to 40, but a parry or
  block pushes your next charge back 10 percent.

{y}Katana: Chain{/}
  Combos run one hit longer, yet after a combo the
  next attack on you meets no evasion.

{y}Ninja Sword: Unseen{/}
  Hits cannot be parried or blocked, though the
  dodge still applies. Every blade carries Blind
  10 percent on hit, and some add a second status.

{y}Dagger: Swift{/}
  The fastest charge, frequent combos, and a little
  evade on the blade.

{y}Dagger and Ninja Sword: Glancing{/}
  Against heavy armor, hits fall to an eighth of
  the attack, not a quarter.

{y}Fists: Cadence{/}
  Attacks on one foe in a row hit 6 percent harder
  each, up to 30 percent, and quicken your next
  action. A full streak counts as a counter for
  {y}Ki Flow{/}. Switching foes restarts the ramp.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Ranged
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights in its own way.
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Bow: Volley{/}
  The keenest critical chance among the ranged
  weapons.

{y}Crossbow: Afflict{/}
  The bolt's status chance is doubled, up to 100
  percent. Bolts take a little longer to load.

{y}Gun: True aim{/}
  A gunner's shots never miss, Blind or not, and
  ignore Defense. Damage depends on the gun alone,
  and the gun charges slowly.

{y}Hand-bomb: Barrage{/}
  The bombs you load decide the status, 25 percent
  on hit, and some carry none.
  Chaos Bombs, which Confuse, and Stun Bombs, which
  Stop, set up a Time Mage's {y}Detonate{/}.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Magick
tips.body:
Every weapon family fights in its own way.
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Rod: Mend{/}
  Healing spells heal 20 percent more while held.
  Potions are unchanged. A heal that overflows
  draws {y}Lure{/} to the caster.

{y}Staff: Channel{/}
  Element potency, and the most Magick of the
  caster weapons.

{y}Mace: Spellbreak{/}
  Hits burn MP equal to 10 percent of the damage,
  at most 10 percent of the foe's pool.

{y}Measure: Tempo{/}
  Each measure grants one status to an ally it
  strikes: Protect, Shell, Bravery, Invisible,
  Haste or Bubble, by tier.

{y}Pole: Counterflow{/}
  Counters even without the {y}Counter{/} augment, found
  on the {y}Battle Harness{/} or {y}Magepower Shishak{/},
  and twice as often with it. Blows taken build the
  next counter, and the pole strikes Magick Resist.
  Its evade is 25 to 30, so its counters can swing.
